title: Framed configuration embedding
statement: Let $k,l$ be natural numbers, let $S$ and $H$ be state sets, let $x$ be a finite Boolean input word, choose $q\in S$, and let $\iota$ inject the $k$ source tape indices into the $l$ host tape indices. Let $e:S\to H$ be a map, let $T_j:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$ and $h_j\in\mathbb{Z}$ specify ambient contents and head positions for each host tape $j$, and let $c$ and $d$ be configurations on $x$ with $k$ and $l$ work tapes and state sets $S$ and $H$, respectively. Suppose the optional state of $c$, mapped by $e$, equals the optional state of $d$; their input-head positions and outputs agree; and for each source tape $i$, its contents and head position in $c$ equal those of host tape $\iota(i)$ in $d$. Suppose also that for every host tape $j$ outside the image of $\iota$, $T_j$ and $h_j$ equal its contents and head position in $d$. Then embedding $c$ into the host tapes using these ambient contents and head positions, with empty output prefix, and mapping its state by $e$ gives exactly $d$.
